description: RemitCheap compares rates, fees, recipient amounts, and delivery speeds from independent money transfer providers. It can list available comparison corridors and rank provider quotes by value or speed. RemitCheap does not send money or process transfers; users open the selected provider to confirm pricing and complete a transaction.

defaultPrompt: What are the cheapest and fastest ways to send $500 from the United States to Mexico?
